senses.definition: A fair valuation or estimate of merit, worth, weight, etc.; recognition of excellence; gratitude and esteem.
examples: We give to you this trophy as a token of our appreciation of all your years of service.
an appreciation of the difficulties before us

quotes.text: The English, until relatively recently, seem to have imagined “English” and “British” to be interchangeable, as if Britain was just a bigger England. Our dualism gave us a better appreciation of the nation-state we lived in, though if Britain was a “nation” as well as a “state”, where did that leave Scotland?
quotes.reference: 2014 September 16, Ian Jack, “Is this the end of Britishness”, in The Guardian:
